Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 131. Category: technique. Rank 1.

Rank 1 Weapon technique
Ki Cost: 6 ki
Casting Prerequisite: 1 Simple or Martial Melee
Weapon that you are proficient with.
Casting Time: 1 Action
Range: Weapon’s Range
Duration: Instantaneous
Chargeable: Yes
Raise your weapon high above your head for an
empowered attack. Roll a combo attack roll dealing
your equipped weapon’s damage die + 1d6 on a hit.
This attack roll is a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.
